description_en: Deletes a private access tag from your Alibaba Cloud account
description_zh: 删除当前阿里云账号下内网访问标签
name: DeletePrivateAccessTag

parameters.description_en:
The ID of the private access tag. You can obtain the tag ID from the responses of the following operations:

- [ListPrivateAccessTags](~~ListPrivateAccessTags~~): Queries a list of private access tags.

- [CreatePrivateAccessTag](~~CreatePrivateAccessTag~~): Creates a private access tag.
parameters.description_zh:
内网访问标签ID。取值来源：
- [ListPrivateAccessTags](~~ListPrivateAccessTags~~)：批量查询内网访问标签。
- [CreatePrivateAccessTag](~~CreatePrivateAccessTag~~)：创建内网访问标签。
